site-layout.label: Site layout
site-layout.description: Shared announcement, navigation and footer. App owns path and page children; edit the existing layout rather than nesting another full site shell.

app.label: Application router
app.description: History API router and page-state owner. Navigation and route creation stay in source.

home-page.label: The garden page
home-page.description: Homepage, hero, collection grid and visitor information.

gallery-page.label: Gallery page
gallery-page.description: Filtered photographs and modal state. Local photo/dialog helpers require their existing data and callback wiring.

visit-page.label: Plan your visit page
visit-page.description: Visitor information, shared opening times and FAQ disclosures.

tickets-page.label: Tickets page
tickets-page.description: Local demo booking form; owns quantities, totals, validation and confirmation. No payments or real reservations.

class-groups-page.label: Class groups demonstration
class-groups-page.description: Conditional class editing examples, shared local SeasonCard and state toggle. Preserves intentional class merge overrides.
